body.name: Observable synchronized Zhang--Dai construction handle
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Hdl}_{\mathrm{SI}}\) is the following observable rule-development program. Start from Zhang's rules R0--R10 on the observational signature on \(U_0=V\), associated with \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_\eta(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\), and on each \(k\in[K]\) full signature on \(U_k\), associated with the pooled selected law \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\). Compute \(\mathsf C_{\mathrm{sel}}(\mathcal O)\) from intervention-created adjacencies and observational-unshielded-noncollider closure, and investigate propagation of forbidden signature transitions along shortest uncovered paths certified by \(\operatorname{Reach}_{\mathrm{cert},\mathcal O}\). Enforce Dai et al.'s disjunction \(Z_k=T_k(\eta)\cup((F_k(\eta)\setminus T_k(\eta))\cap A(\eta))\) only as a witness obligation, without identifying \(T_k(\eta)\) with \(Z_k\). The latent objects \(L_{A(\eta)}\), \(\operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B)\), and \(\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\) may be used only in a semantic extension proof after a compatible base model is chosen; none is a rule premise. The handle specifies constraints on a prospective finite list in \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{SI}}\); it does not assert that such a sound and complete list has been derived.
